messages.subject: Receiver checks for the approved corpus
messages.body: I have Mara’s approval. The client teams can take the same batch if it opens on all their readers. I’ll keep the handoff open until we have all three readbacks from bundle-17.

messages.subject: The client team restored the batch
messages.body:
All eight opened on every receiver. The source references match too. I filed Mara’s approval and closed delivery.

Eli’s looking at putting the portability check on the regular release list.
